मुझे आश्चर्य होता है जब मैं देखता हूँ कि कैसे इतिहास में ईश्वर अपने लोगों का उपयोग अपने नाम की महिमा के लिए करते हैं। वह कमजोर चीजों का उपयोग बुद्धिमानों को चकित करने के लिए करते हैं; निचली चीजों का उपयोग सांसारिक बुद्धियों की बुद्धिमत्ता को नष्ट करने के लिए करते हैं। ईश्वर शारीरिक कमजोरी, कठिनाई, क्षति, शोक, परिश्रम और पीड़ा का उपयोग हमारी आध्यात्मिक निधियों को बढ़ाने और यहाँ पृथ्वी पर अपने राज्य का निर्माण करने के लिए करते हैं!

यह भजन मेरे परिवार और मेरे लिए कई वर्षों पहले प्रिय हो गया जब हम अपने चौथे आनुवंशिक रूप से चुनौतीपूर्ण बच्चे के जन्म की प्रतीक्षा कर रहे थे। हमें पता था कि वह हमारे साथ बहुत देर तक नहीं रह सकेगी। वह केवल तीन दिन की आयु में इस संसार से चली गई। इस भजन का शोध करने पर, मैं हैरान था यह जानकर कि जिस व्यक्ति की कहानी ने इस भजन को प्रेरित किया था उसने अपने नौ बच्चों में से आठ को खो दिया था।

इस आदमी की कहानी ध्यान देने योग्य है। पृथ्वी पर उसके 61 वर्ष शोक और क्षति, उत्पीड़न और कारावास से चिह्नित थे। फिर भी, मसीह के प्रति उसकी समर्पण असाधारण थी, और ईश्वर के लिए उसकी ज्वाला और सुसमाचार प्रचार करने के लिए उसका उत्साह उसके अंतिम दिन तक कभी मंद नहीं हुआ।

सैमुअल रदरफोर्ड, एक समृद्ध किसान के पुत्र, का जन्म वर्ष 1600 में हुआ था। उसका जीवन स्कॉटलैंड के छोटे गाँव निसबेट में शुरू हुआ। जब हम उसके जीवन की झलक देखते हैं, तो हम सैमुअल के शुरुआती वर्षों में ईश्वर के काम का हाथ देखते हैं। केवल तीन वर्ष की आयु में, वह अपने दोस्तों के साथ खेल रहा था जब वह शहर के कुएँ में गिर पड़ा। उसकी बहन और दोस्त मदद के लिए भागे। जब वे लौटे, तो उन्होंने देखा कि बहुत गीला सैमुअल कुएँ के पास घास पर बैठा है। उन्होंने उससे पूछा कि वह कैसे बाहर आया, और उसका उत्तर था, "एक सुन्दर सफेद आदमी आया और मुझे कुएँ से बाहर खींच लाया।" उसके परिवार ने माना कि उस दिन ईश्वर ने एक स्वर्गदूत भेजा था जिसने उसे बचाया।

जो कुछ हम सैमुअल रदरफोर्ड के बारे में जानते हैं उससे पता चलता है कि उसके दो भाई और एक बहन थे। उसे कम उम्र में स्कूल भेजा गया, और वह एक बहुत परिश्रमी छात्र बन गया। उसने लैटिन और ग्रीक इतनी अच्छी तरह सीखी कि वह अंततः एक प्रोफेसर बन गया। वह लगभग 1624 में यूफम हैमिल्टन से विवाह करके एडिनबर्ग यूनिवर्सिटी में पढ़ाना शुरू करने के बाद ही शादी की। इस समय, सैमुअल अभी परिवर्तित नहीं हुआ था और केवल अपनी अकादमिक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने में रुचि रखता था।

1626 में, 26 वर्ष की आयु में, सैमुअल को प्रभु यीशु मसीह में एक स्पष्ट और उद्धारक आस्था मिली। उसने कहा, "ओ परन्तु मसीह की एक बचाने वाली दृष्टि है। जब उसने पहली बार मुझ पर देखा मैं बच गया था। उसे केवल एक दृष्टि की कीमत लगी ताकि नरक मेरे लिए खाली हो जाए।" उस क्षण से वह अपने उद्धारकर्ता के बारे में प्रचार करने और बोलने के लिए उत्साह से भर गया। इस जीवन परिवर्तन ने विश्वविद्यालय में ऐसा हलचल मचा दी कि रदरफोर्ड को अपनी प्रोफेसरशिप त्यागनी पड़ी।

1627 में, सैमुअल ने अपनी पत्नी और दो छोटे बच्चों को गैलोवे, स्कॉटलैंड ले जाकर वहां के छोटे चर्च आन्कोथ की पादरशिप शुरू की। वहाँ अपने बुलावे की शुरुआत करते हुए उसने कहा, "मुझे शाही और राजसी स्वामी, मेरे प्रभु यीशु से लोगों के लिए मसीह का प्रचार करने का आदेश मिला है।" उसका उत्साह लोगों के परिवर्तन के लिए था, और कहा जाता है कि वह हमेशा प्रार्थना करता, हमेशा प्रचार करता, हमेशा रोगियों से मिलता, हमेशा पढ़ाता और निर्देश देता, हमेशा लिखता या अध्ययन करता प्रतीत होता था। जिस उत्साह के साथ वह प्रचार करता और अपनी समुदाय की भलाई के लिए जिसे वह परवाह करता था, उसका उन पर गहरा प्रभाव पड़ा। केवल उनके ही नहीं, बल्कि आस-पास के शहरों और गाँवों के लोग भी उसके प्रवचन सुनने आने लगे। एक मित्र ने एक बार बताया, "कई बार मैंने सोचा कि जब वह यीशु मसीह की बात करता तो वह पल्पिट से उड़ जाएगा।"

सैमुअल दुःख और शोक से परे नहीं थे। 1631 में, पादरशिप शुरू करने के केवल चार वर्ष बाद, उसकी पत्नी का निधन हो गया। उसके दो बच्चे भी बीमार हुए और इस दुनिया से चले गए। 1636 में, नौ वर्षों के प्रचार के बाद, उसे अबरडीन के लिए निर्वासित कर दिया गया, जहाँ उसे सुसमाचार प्रचार करने से मना किया गया। यह उसके लिए बहुत कठिन समय था क्योंकि वह अपनी पत्नी और बच्चों के साथ-साथ अपनी मंडली, आन्कोथ की चैर्च की बहुत याद करता था। उसके जीवन का यह समय वास्तव में एक कारण है कि उसे इतनी अच्छी तरह याद किया जाता है, क्योंकि उसने अपने चर्च के लोगों और मित्रों के लिए पत्र लिखना शुरू कर दिया। उसने जिन 365 पत्रों को लिखा उनमें से 220 पत्र उन 22 महीनों के निर्वासन के दौरान लिखे गए थे।

अंततः सरकार का हाथ बदल गया, जिससे गैर-अनुरूपनकारी कवरनांटर्स को अधिक स्वतंत्रता मिली। उसके बाद रदरफोर्ड जल्दी से अपने प्रिय भेड़ियों के पास आन्कोथ लौट आया। लगभग एक वर्ष बाद, 1639 के पतझड़ में, उसने अनिच्छा से आन्कोथ छोड़ दिया लेकिन इस बार सेंट एंड्रयूज़ के सेंट मेरीज़ कॉलेज में धर्मशास्त्र के प्रोफेसर के रूप में नियुक्ति पूरी करने के लिए। यह परिवर्तन उसके लिए कठिन था, क्योंकि वह पुनः अपनी मंडली को बहुत याद करता था। उसने लिखा, "मेरे भेड़ियों से मेरी अलगाव मेरे लिए इतना भारी है कि यह मेरे जीवन को बोझ बना देता है, मैंने कभी मृत्यु के लिए ऐसी लालसा नहीं की। प्रभु इस दुखी मृत्तिका को मदद करे और संभाले।"

नए पद पर पाँच महीने रहने और लगभग दस वर्षों तक अकेले रहने के बाद, 40-वर्षीय सैमुअल ने जीन मैकमैथ से विवाह किया। उनके साथ सात बच्चे हुए। दुख की बात यह है कि उनमें से छह शैशव और बाल्यावस्था में ही मर गए। केवल एक पुत्री एग्नेस नाम की ने वयस्कता तक जीवित रही।

रदरफोर्ड अगले 20 वर्षों तक स्कॉटलैंड में गैर-अनुरूपनकारी आंदोलन में एक प्रभावशाली नेता बने रहे, जब तक कि 1660 तक। क्रॉमवेल की मृत्यु के साथ, राष्ट्र की शासकीय व्यवस्था समाप्त हो गई, और चार्ल्स द्वितीय को सत्ता में बहाल कर दिया गया। एक बार फिर, राजतंत्र का क्रोध सैमुअल पर चला। उसे न्यायाधीश के समक्ष हाज़िर होने के लिए तलब किया गया और सरकार के विरुद्ध उच्च राज्यद्रोह के आरोप में आरोपित किया गया क्योंकि उसने सत्य का प्रचार किया था। उसे फाँसी की प्रतीक्षा में जेल में बंद कर दिया गया। हालांकि, राजा उसे मारने से पहले, सैमुअल काफी बीमार पड़ गए। उसने कहा, "मेरे पास पहले से ही एक उच्चतर न्यायाधीश से एक समन है, और मुझे अपने पहले समन का उत्तर देना चाहिए और जब तुम्हारा दिन आएगा मैं वहाँ रहूँगा जहाँ कुछ राजा और बड़े लोग आते हैं।"

अपने जीवन के अंतिम दिन के देर शाम, प्रश्न "अब तुम मसीह के बारे में क्या सोचते हो?" के उत्तर में उसने इस तरह उत्तर दिया, "ओह, कि मेरी धरती के सभी भाइयों को यह जानने को मिले कि मैंने किस स्वामी की सेवा की है, और आज के दिन मुझे कैसी शांति मिली है! मैं मसीह में सोऊँगा, और जब मैं जागूँगा, मैं उसकी समानता से संतुष्ट हो जाऊँगा। यह रात द्वार बंद कर देगी, और मेरा लंगर परदे के भीतर रख देगी, और मैं सुबह पाँच बजे के आसपास सोकर चला जाऊँगा। महिमा! महिमा मेरे निर्माता और मेरे उद्धारकर्ता को सदा के लिये! मैं जीवित रहूँगा और उसकी आराधना करूँगा। ओह, उसे आलिंगन करने के लिए बाँहें! ओह, एक अच्छी तरह से सुरबद्ध हार्प के लिये! महिमा! महिमा इम्मानुएल के देश में वास करती है!" ये शब्द उसकी पत्नी, बेटी और मित्रों ने सुने, और वह वास्तव में सुबह पांच बजे तक अपने स्वामी के साथ थे।

लगभग दो शताब्दियों बाद, एनी रॉस कज़िन, एक स्कॉटिश कवयित्री और भजन रचनाकार तथा एक मंत्री की पत्नी, सैमुअल रदरफोर्ड के जीवन और लेखन से प्रेरित हुईं। उन्होंने उसके जीवन का सार एक जीवनीात्मक भजन में संक्षेप किया, "The Sands of Time are Sinking"। यह भजन पहली बार 1857 में क्रिश्चियन ट्रेजरी में प्रकाशित हुआ था। मूल उन्नीस छंदों में से केवल चार ही हमारे भजन पुस्तकों में प्रयुक्त होते हैं। (बोल्ड कॉपी में)

समय के रेते डूब रहे हैं,
स्वर्ग की भोर टूट रही है,
उस गर्मियों की सुबह जिसके लिये मैंने तड़पा,
वह सुन्दर, मधुर सुबह जाग उठी है:
अंधेरी, अंधेरी रही है मध्यरात्रि,
पर दिन की पहली किरण पास है,
और महिमा—महिमा वास करती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

2. ओ! यह सदैव अच्छा है,
ओ! यह सदा ही अच्छा रहेगा
मेरा घोंसला किसी जंगल में न लटका रहे
इस मृत्यु-निश्चत तट पर!
हाँ, दुनिया व्यर्थ विलीन हो जाए,
जैसे जहाज से खण्ड हटता है,
जबकि महिमा—महिमा वास करती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

3. वहाँ शेरोन का लाल गुलाब
अपने हृदय का सबसे गहरा कली खोलता है।
और स्वर्ग की वायु को भर देता है
मनोहर सुगंध से;
ओ, उसकी कली को देखना कैसा आनंददायक होगा,
जबकि उसकी खुशबू से व्यवहारित होकर
जहाँ महिमा—महिमा वास करती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

4. वहाँ राज्यभूषण उस सुन्दरता में है,
बिना किसी परदा के दिखाई देता है:
यह एक सुयोग्य यात्रा होती,
भले ही बीच में सात मौतें भी हों:
मेमना अपनी सुंदर सेना के साथ,
सिय्योन पर्वत पर खड़ा है;
और महिमा—महिमा वास करती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

5. ओ! मसीह वही स्रोत्र है,
प्रेम का गहरा मधुर कुआँ!
पृथ्वी पर जिन धाराओं का मैंने स्वाद लिया,
उनसे गहरा मैं ऊपर पिउँगा;
वहाँ, महासागर की पूर्णता को पाने के लिये,
उसकी दया फैलती है,
और महिमा—महिमा वास करती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

6. यहां तक कि आन्कोथ स्वर्ग नहीं था—
यहाँ तक कि प्रचार मसीह नहीं था;
और मेरे समुद्र-धारा-घसीटे कैद में
मेरे प्रभु और मैं मिले थे:
और सदैव मेरी सबसे अँधेरी आँधी-घने बादल
एक इंद्रधनुष से स्थापित थे,
जो इम्मानुएल के देश में वास करने वाली महिमा से पकड़ा गया था।

7. परन्तु उसने अपने पराक्रमी प्रेम से
एक स्वर्ग बनाया,
एक छोटा नया यरूशलेम,
ऊपर वाले जैसा,—
"प्रभु, मुझे पानी के उस पार ले चलो,"
मेरा जोरदार आह्वान होता,
"मुझे प्रेम के अपने देश में ले चलो,
इम्मानुएल के देश में।"

8. परन्तु फूलों को रात की ठंडी अँधेरी चाहिए,
चांदनी और ओस की भी;
ऐसे ही मसीह, जिससे किसी ने प्रेम किया,
अक्सर अपनी शोभा छीन लेते थे;
और तब, गैर-मौजूदगी के कारण,
मैं अपनी उलझी आत्मा की जाँच करता—
पर महिमा, बिना छाया के, चमकती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

9. आन्कोथ के छोटे पक्षी,
जिन्हें वे धन्य गिनते थे,—
अब, अधिक सुखी वेदियों के पास,
मेरे घोसले बनाने जाते हैं:
इनके ऊपर कोई मौन नहीं छाया करता,
उनके चारों ओर कोई कब्रें नहीं हैं,
क्योंकि अमर महिमा वास करती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

10. सुन्दर आन्कोथ सोलवे के पास,
मेरे लिये तू अभी भी प्रिय है!
स्वर्ग के किनारे से भी मैं तेरे लिये
एक आँसू टपका दूँगा।
ओ! यदि आन्कोथ से एक आत्मा
मुझे परमेश्वर के दाहिने हाथ पर मिले,
मेरा स्वर्ग दो स्वर्ग हो जाएगा,
इम्मानुएल के देश में!

11. मैंने स्वर्ग की ओर संघर्ष किया है,
तूफ़ान, हवा और ज्वार के खिलाफ;—
अब, जैसे एक थका हुआ यात्री,
जो अपने मार्गदर्शक पर टिका है,
संध्या के सायों के बीच,
जबकि जीवन की अवशिष्ट रेत डूबती है,
मैं इम्मानुएल के देश से उभरती महिमा का अभिनंदन करता हूँ।

12. गहराईयों ने जीवन के मार्ग को पार किया,
कांटेदार बाड़ तेज थी;
अब ये सब मेरे पीछे हैं,—
ओ! एक अच्छी तरह सुरबद्ध हार्प के लिये!
ओ! यज्ञवाहिनीhallelujah में शामिल होने के लिये
उस विजयी गिरोह के साथ,
जो गाते हैं जहाँ महिमा वास करती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में!

13. कृपा और न्याय के साथ
उसने मेरे समय की जाली बुनी,
और सदैव शोक की ओसें
उसकी प्रेम से चमकीली हुईं!
मैं उस हाथ की स्तुति करूँगा जिसने मार्गदर्शन किया,
मैं उस हृदय की स्तुति करूँगा जिसने योजना बनाई,
जब मैं सिंहासन पर बैठूँगा जहाँ महिमा वास करती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

14. शीघ्र ही महिमा का प्याला
पृथ्वी के कड़वे से कड़वे दुखों को धो देगा,
शीघ्र ही रेगिस्तान की काँटी
ईडन के गुलाब में खिल उठेगी:
शाप आशीर्वाद में बदल जाएगा–
उस नाम को जो पृथ्वी पर वर्जित है,
सफेद पत्थर पर उकेरा जाएगा
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

15. ओह! मैं अपने प्रिय का हूँ,
और मेरा प्रिय मेरा है!
वह एक गरीब नीच पापी को ले आता है
अपने “मदिरालय” में:
मैं उसकी सिद्धि पर खड़ा हूँ,
मैं किसी और आधार को नहीं जानता,
यहाँ तक कि जहाँ महिमा वास करती है भी नहीं
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

16. मैं यीशु में दृढ़ निद्रा सोऊँगा,
उसकी समानता से भरा उठूँगा,
जीऊँगा और उसकी आराधना करूँगा,
उसे अपनी आँखों से देखने के लिए:
मेरे और पुनरुत्थान के बीच
केवल स्वर्गोद्यान खड़ा है;
फिर—फिर महिमा के वास के लिये
इम्मानुएल के देश में!

17. दुल्हन अपने वस्त्र पर नहीं दृष्टि लगाती,
परन्तु अपने प्रिय वर के चेहरे पर;
मैं महिमा पर नहीं निहारूँगा,
पर अपने कृपा-राजा पर—
नहीं उस मुकुट पर जो वह देता है,
परन्तु उसके छिद्रित हाथ पर:
मेमना ही समस्त महिमा है
इम्मानुएल के देश की।

18. मैंने तिरस्कार और घृणा सहा है,
मैंने अन्याय और लज्जा सहा है,
पृथ्वी के गर्वीले लोगों ने मुझे अपमानित किया है,
मसीह के त्रि-धन्य नाम के कारण:
जहाँ परमेश्वर ने अपना मुहर सबसे सुंदर ढंग से लगाई है
वहाँ उन्होंने अपना घिनौना छाप लगाया है;
पर न्याय मध्यान्ह की तरह चमकता है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

19. उन्होंने मुझे अपने सामने तलब किया है,
पर वहाँ मैं नहीं आ सकता,—
मेरे प्रभु कहते हैं, “यहाँ ऊपर आओ,”
मेरे प्रभु कहते हैं, “स्वागत है घर!”
मेरा राजा अब अपने श्वेत सिंहासन पर है,
मेरी उपस्थिति का आदेश देता है,
जहाँ महिमा—महिमा वास करती है
इम्मानुएल के देश में।

इस गीत के लिए उपयुक्त पूरक धुन 1800 के आसपास एक फ्रांसीसी संगीतकार, क्रेटियन डी'उर्हान द्वारा रचित थी। यह शब्दों के अनुरूप अच्छी तरह मेल खाती है—इसका गंभीर ताल शब्दों की गंभीरता से मेल खाता है। आखिरी वाक्यांश की आरोही सुररेखा उस प्रत्याशित आनंद के साथ बिल्कुल मेल खाती है जो प्रतिबिंब में व्यक्त किया गया है—"And glory, glory dwelleth in Immanuel's land."

जैसा कि हम इस भजन के इतिहास को समाप्त करते हैं, आइए हम उन लोगों के जीवन में ईश्वर की प्रोविडेंस पर आश्चर्य करना जारी रखें जो हमारे पहले गए। हम अपने पूरे दिल से मसीह का पालन करें और स्वामी के उपयोग के लिए तैयार पात्र बनें! हमारे साथ लेने के लिए सैमुअल रदरफोर्ड का एक अंतिम उद्धरण। "वे कुछ भी नहीं खोते जो मसीह को पाते हैं।"

“It is so hard,” the man sitting across from me said. “We’ve been married for nearly fifty years, but I never expected anything like this.”

“What is going on?” I asked Al, sympathetically.

“It’s Lisa,” he said. “You know her memory has been slipping for a little while. Well, we went to the neurologist like you told us to, and they ordered a whole bunch of tests and a brain scan of some sort. Then, they told her she had dementia.”

“I thought that was what was going on,” I replied.

“I know you told us that,” Al said. “Well, there are times she doesn’t recognize me. She looks at me blankly like she is wondering what crazy stranger has gotten into her house.”

“That’s got to be hard,” I said.

“The only thing I’ve found that brings her back to herself is to go outside and call her on her cell phone. I tell her to come out to the garage, I’ve got something to show her. Somehow when I do that, it brings her back to the present and lets her know who I am – for a little bit, anyway.”

We moved on to talking about other things, but I could tell that Al’s heart was breaking. His wife of 48 years looked the same as ever on the outside and yet, she was a completely different person.

I’d like to explore some of the challenges in dealing with dementia.

Dementia in the Bible

Ecclesiastes 12:1-7 gives a somewhat dismal view of the aging process. “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them; While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened, And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low; Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern. Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.”

In this passage, the poetic description seems to speak of loss of teeth, loss of hearing, unsteady gait, and general frailty. It is hard to say if any of these images speak of memory loss. What is certain is that the passage begins with a command: “Remember!”

This is not the only place in Scripture where humans are commanded to remember. Over and over, we are told to remember God. We are to make certain that we instruct our children about Him. “And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up” (Deuteronomy 6:7).

The time may come when we are not able to remember anymore. The most important thing – even as we think about the subject of dementia is that we remember the One who made us and follow Him with all our hearts.

What Dementia is

Dementia is any illness that causes a loss of memory, reasoning, and social functioning. Most people think mostly of the loss of memory. I suppose this is because early in the illness other people notice things like difficulty finding words and frequent repetition of stories.

Social functioning is often maintained until late in the illness. If you ask someone with mild dementia if they know today’s date, they will likely answer, “Oh, you know, I stopped paying attention to things like that when I retired.”

The most common cause of dementia is Alzheimer’s dementia – at least 70 percent of people who have progressive memory loss have Alzheimer’s dementia. Alzheimer’s seems to be related to proteins called amyloid, which get deposited in the brain and prevent nerve cells from communicating with each other.

Other causes are vascular dementia, where blockages in the blood vessels in the brain cause the death of nerve cells. Lewy Body Dementia is a sort of memory loss that is associated with Parkinson’s Disease. Approximately eighty percent of people with Parkinson’s Disease will eventually develop dementia.

Diagnosing Dementia

If family members suspect someone is developing memory loss, the best thing is to bring them to their primary care provider for an evaluation. Along with doing a physical exam, the doctor will typically do things like have the patient draw a clock and do a mini mental status exam, which asks the patient to answer a lot of simple questions and do some short-term recall of items.

Blood tests including a thyroid and Vitamin B12 level would be done. A brain scan or ultrasound of the neck arteries might be done as well.

The goal is to identify areas that can be treated and take care of those.

Eliminate Medications

Many medications increase the risk of memory issues. As people get older, trying to avoid these medications is helpful to prevent the development of dementia.

Anticholinergic medications are probably the biggest culprit that I encounter. The most common of these medications are older antihistamines like diphenhydramine (used as either a sleep aid or allergy pill) and doxylamine (used as a sleep aid). In one study, patients who took an anticholinergic medication for the equivalent of three years had a significantly higher risk of dementia than patients who took these sorts of medications for less than three months.1 Older depression medications can also fall into this category.

Anxiety medications, called benzodiazepines, have also been associated with memory issues. Studies indicate that patients who take these medications have a higher risk of developing dementia than patients who do not take them.2

Seizure medications may make thinking ability worse as well. Having a seizure disorder seems to increase the risk of dementia, but certain older medications like valproate and gabapentin seem to make it harder for older people to think clearly, and shifting to lower-risk seizure medications is in order (if possible) for older people.

There are times when someone needs to take medication, but as patients get older, it is important to think about the risks of those medications. There is a list of medications that are wisest to avoid for patients over 65 years of age, called the Beers List. Substituting similar medications with fewer side effects or using lower doses is recommended.3

Medical Treatments

The first rule when dealing with dementia is to make certain that all of the metabolic things are in as good control as possible. So, if someone has diabetes, it is best to make certain that their sugar is in as good control as possible. If someone has high blood pressure, make certain that it is well-regulated (this is particularly true if someone has vascular dementia).

There are several different classes of medications that are approved for treating dementia. One group is the cholinesterase inhibitors. These medications raise the level of a chemical called acetylcholine in the brain and peripheral nervous system. These medications are certainly not miracle drugs and at best they seem to slow the progression of memory loss and do not really restore previous brain function.

The other medication is called memantine. It works by targeting the glutamate receptor in the brain. Just as with the cholinesterase inhibitors, the effects are not huge and the end result only slows the memory loss.

Both of these medications are generic, and it is reasonable to try them and see how someone responds to them.

One last medication to mention is called lecanemab. It is an IV infusion that targets amyloid, a kind of protein that develops in the brain of people with Alzheimer’s dementia. The medication seems to work quite well at clearing amyloid from patient’s brains. This medication is very expensive ($26,500 per year)and it has been linked to an increase in strokes. In the studies, dementia symptoms were only slowed by about 30 percent compared with a placebo.

There are no other medications currently approved to treat dementia.

Non-medication Therapies

There are several things that people can do to help slow the progression of dementia. These can be helpful for people who have a strong family history of dementia and want to prevent its onset.

Cardiovascular exercise is very important. Doctors mention exercise in relation to nearly every chronic illness because it has been shown to work. In the case of dementia, people who exercise regularly have about 30 percent decreased risk of developing the disease. Regular exercise seems to slow the progression of dementia.4

Doing puzzles that require mental activity, like Sudoku or crossword puzzles seems to help slow the progression of memory loss and may also reduce the chance of developing dementia.

Lastly, it is helpful to learn something new. People who learn a new skill or focus on learning a new language help their memories quite a bit. A study compared older people who learned a new skill with people who went to social events.

The point seems to be that our brains need to be pushed to create new pathways or they will tend to break down.5

Caring For Someone with Dementia

Caring for someone with dementia is challenging in a number of ways. It is often difficult to know how much independence to allow the person. There have been many books written on this subject, but there are a few things that are worth mentioning.

It is important to avoid dangerous things. The two most dangerous things for someone with faulty memory are driving and cooking. Both of these seem commonplace, and the person may seem to be doing fine, but they can become a problem very quickly.

The danger of driving a car or a buggy is twofold. First, some people freeze at certain points, not remembering how to do a particular skill. This can be a problem, not only for them but also for others on the road.

Second, older people can start off on short journeys to a local store or restaurant and end up getting lost. I have had patients who ended up driving around for hours trying to find their way home when they got confused driving to town.

Cooking, of course, really comes down to a question of remembering to set timers and take things off the stove or out of the oven at the appropriate time.

Many times, people who have dementia do not realize how much their abilities have slipped and resist the idea that they need to give up the car keys. Maybe it simply comes down to a loss of independence, but it is hard to face the fact that you are no longer safe behind the wheel.

Try to keep things the same within the room and the home. Even small changes in room arrangement can be enough to upset the situation. Taking someone out of their home – for instance, admitting them to the hospital often makes things a lot worse. Suddenly, confusion that only seemed mild before is now extremely high.

If there is a fruit of the spirit that is key for dealing with someone with dementia, it is patience. None of us has as much patience as we need, as dementia spreads that patience awfully thin.

People with dementia often act like children on a long trip. They ask over and over when they are going home. They wonder where dead relatives are or why the children aren’t home yet. No amount of explanation helps, because only a minute or two after they ask the question, they have forgotten the answer and are asking again.

Their skills often wax and wane. One day, they can button their shirt, and the next day, that skill seems to have flown out the window. It is easy to believe that they aren’t “trying hard” and that they could do more if they would only make the effort.

Unfortunately, the fact that someone with dementia could do something yesterday doesn’t mean that they can remember how to do it today. Getting upset with them only makes these things worse as it adds anxiety to a person who already lacks the memory of how to do a skill.

As much as possible, answer the person gently even if it is the fifty-third time that you have answered the same question. Use distractions as well. If there is an activity that they can still do, such as sewing or jigsaw puzzles (even children’s puzzles with really big pieces), get them to do it. Late in the illness, letting them look at books with pretty pictures or sometimes even giving them a baby doll to hold can help settle them and distract them from their anxieties of the moment.

Get Others to Help

It is easy to become frustrated. Trying to provide all of the care needed by yourself is not a long-term solution. Dementia care is a marathon and not a sprint. Many people live for years after the diagnosis, and even though their physical body remains relatively strong, they require more and more care.

One of the blessings of having family connections and church communities is that we have people who are available to provide assistance.

Having family members or friends step in to give you some respite is key to not becoming seriously burned out or even angry with someone that you care about. It is best to take some time away periodically before you are mentally depleted. You may think you are doing fairly well, but all of us have a tendency to get weary in well doing if we never get a break.

Conclusion

I wish there were more medical solutions for dementia. Perhaps more will come later. For now, medications are quite limited.

The key is to put the fruit of the Spirit into practice. “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance: against such there is no law” (Galatians 5:22-23).

Even on the most frustrating days, people who are dealing with severe memory loss need love, gentleness, and patience from their family members. It is only through the Holy Spirit’s power that we can provide the care that is needed for someone whose body is strong, but who no longer even recognizes you.

“Ni ngumu sana,” mtu aliyekaa kinyume nami alisema. “Tumeolewa takriban miaka hamsini, lakini sikuweza kutarajia kitu kama hiki.”

“Nini kinaendelea?” niliuliza Al, kwa huruma.

“Ni Lisa,” alisema. “Unajua kumbukumbu zake imekuwa ikipungua kwa muda. Kweli, tulimpeleka kwa daktari wa neva kama ulivyotuambia, na waliagiza vipimo vingi na aina ya skani ya ubongo. Kisha, wamwambia ana ugonjwa wa demensia.”

“Nilidhani ndiyo kilikuwa kinatokea,” nilijibu.

“Najua ulikuwa umetuambia hivyo,” Al alisema. “Kweli, kuna wakati hana fahamu juu yangu. Ananitazama bila hisia kana kwamba anajiuliza ni mgeni wa wazimu gani ameingia nyumbani kwake.”

“Hiyo lazima iwe ngumu,” nilisema.

“Kitu pekee nilichokigundua kinamrudisha kuwa yeye ni kwenda nje na kumpigia simu yake ya mkononi. Namwambia aje gerejini, nina kitu cha kumwonyesha. Kwa namna fulani ninapoifanya hivyo, inamrudisha kwa wakati uliopo na kumfahamisha nani mimi — kwa muda mfupi, angalau.”

Tulihamia kwenye mazungumzo kuhusu mambo mengine, lakini ningeweza kusema kwamba moyo wa Al ulikuwa unavunjika. Mkewe wa miaka 48 alionekana sawa nje lakini, ndani, alikuwa mtu tofauti kabisa.

Ningependa kuchunguza baadhi ya changamoto za kushughulika na demensia.

Demensia katika Biblia

Ecclesiastes 12:1-7 gives a somewhat dismal view of the aging process. “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them; While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened, And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low; Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern. Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.”

Katika kifungu hiki, maelezo ya kishairi yanaonekana kuzungumzia kupoteza meno, kupoteza kusikia, kutembea kwa kusuasua, na uzito wa mwili kwa ujumla. Ni vigumu kusema kama mojawapo ya picha hizi inazungumzia kupoteza kumbukumbu. Kinachojulikana ni kwamba kifungu kinaanza na amri: “Kumbuka!”

Hili si eneo pekee katika Maandiko ambapo wanadamu wanaamriwa kukumbuka. Mara kwa mara, tunasimiwa tukumbuke Mungu. Tunapaswa kuhakikisha kwamba tunawafundisha watoto wetu kuhusu Yeye. “And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up” (Deuteronomy 6:7).

Muda unaweza kuja ambapo hatuwezi kukumbuka tena. Jambo muhimu zaidi — hata tunapofikiri kuhusu mada ya demensia — ni kwamba tukumbuke Yule aliye kataa kuumba na kumuifuata kwa mioyo yetu yote.

Kile Demensia Ilivyo

Demensia ni ugonjwa wowote unaosababisha kupoteza kumbukumbu, uwezo wa kufikiri kwa mantiki, na utendaji wa kijamii. Watu wengi huwa wanafikiri hasa kupoteza kumbukumbu. Nadhani hii ni kwa sababu mwanzoni mwa ugonjwa watu wengine wanaona mambo kama ugumu wa kupata maneno na kurudia hadithi mara kwa mara.

Utendaji wa kijamii mara nyingi huendelea hadi mwishoni mwa ugonjwa. Ukimuuliza mtu mwenye demensia ya kiponde kama anajua tarehe ya leo, watajibu kwa uwezekano, “Ah, unajua, niliacha kuzingatia mambo kama hayo nilipoenda kustaafu.”

Sababu ya kawaida zaidi ya demensia ni demensia ya Alzheimer — angalau asilimia 70 ya watu walio na kupoteza kumbukumbu kinaendelea wana demensia ya Alzheimer. Alzheimer inaonekana kuhusiana na protini zinazoitwa amyloid, ambazo huwekwa kwenye ubongo na kuzuia seli za neva kuwasiliana kwa usahihi.

Sababu nyingine ni demensia ya mishipa ya damu (vascular dementia), ambapo kuziba kwa mishipa ya damu kwenye ubongo husababisha kifo cha seli za neva. Lewy Body Dementia ni aina ya kupoteza kumbukumbu inayohusiana na Ugonjwa wa Parkinson. Takriban asilimia themanini ya watu wenye Ugonjwa wa Parkinson hatimaye watapata demensia.

Utambuzi wa Demensia

Ikiwa wanajamii wanashuku mtu anaanza kupoteza kumbukumbu, jambo bora ni kumpeleka kwa mtoa huduma wa msingi kwa tathmini. Pamoja na kufanya uchunguzi wa kimwili, daktari kawaida hufanya mambo kama kumwomba mgonjwa kuchora saa na kufanya mtihani wa hali ndogo ya akili (mini mental status exam), unaomwomba mgonjwa kujibu maswali mengi rahisi na kufanya kukumbuka kwa muda mfupi.

Mtihani wa damu ikiwa ni pamoja na thyroide na kiwango cha Vitamini B12 utafanywa. Skani ya ubongo au ultrasound ya mishipa ya shingo inaweza kufanywa pia.

Lengo ni kutambua maeneo yanayoweza kutibiwa na kuyashughulikia.

Ondoa Dawa Zinazoweza Kuathiri

Dawa nyingi huongeza hatari ya matatizo ya kumbukumbu. Watu wanapokuwa wazee, kuepuka dawa hizi kunasaidia kuzuia maendeleo ya demensia.

Dawa za antikolinergiki zinaweza kuwa hatari kubwa niliyokutana nayo. Dawa za kawaida za kundi hili ni antihistamines za zamani kama diphenhydramine (inayotumika kama dawa ya kulala au ya pumu) na doxylamine (inayotumika kama dawa ya kulala). Katika utafiti mmoja, wagonjwa waliotumia dawa ya antikolinergiki kwa sawa na miaka mitatu walikuwa na hatari kubwa ya kupata demensia kuliko wagonjwa waliotumia aina hizi za dawa kwa chini ya miezi mitatu.1 Dawa za zamani za kupunguza msongo wa mawazo pia zinaweza kuingia katika kundi hili.

Dawa za wasiwasi, zinazoitwa benzodiazepines, pia zimehusishwa na matatizo ya kumbukumbu. Utafiti unaonyesha kwamba wagonjwa wanaotumia dawa hizi wana hatari kubwa ya kupata demensia kuliko wale wasiotumia.2

Dawa za kuhifadhi mshtuko (seizure) zinaweza kufanya uwezo wa kufikiri kuwa mbaya zaidi pia. Kuwa na ugonjwa wa mshtuko kunaonekana kuongeza hatari ya demensia, lakini dawa fulani za zamani kama valproate na gabapentin zinaonekana kufanya wazee wachekewe kuzifikiria kwa uwazi, na kubadilisha kwenda dawa za mshtuko zenye hatari ndogo ni busara (ikiwa inawezekana) kwa wazee.

Kuna nyakati mtu anahitaji kutumia dawa, lakini watu wanapokomaa, ni muhimu kufikiria hatari za zile dawa. Kuna orodha ya dawa zinazopaswa kuepukwa kwa wagonjwa waliopitiliza umri wa miaka 65, inayojulikana kama Orodha ya Beers (Beers List). Kupendekezwa ni kubadilisha kwa dawa zinazofanana zenye madhara machache au kutumia dozi ndogo.

Tiba za Dawa

Sheria ya kwanza wakati wa kushughulika na demensia ni kuhakikisha kwamba mambo yote ya kimetaboliki yako katika udhibiti mzuri iwezekanavyo. Kwa hivyo, ikiwa mtu ana kisukari, ni bora kuhakikisha kwamba sukari yao iko katika udhibiti mzuri kadri inavyoweza. Ikiwa mtu ana shinikizo la damu la juu, hakikisha linadhibitiwa vizuri (hii ni hasa kweli ikiwa mtu ana demensia ya mishipa ya damu).

Kuna makundi kadhaa ya dawa zilizoidhinishwa kutibu demensia. Kundi moja ni vinavyodhibiti cholinesterase. Dawa hizi huongeza kiwango cha kemikali inayoitwa acetylcholine katika ubongo na mfumo wa neva wa pembeni. Dawa hizi hakika si za miujiza na kwa kiwango bora zinadhihirika kupunguza kasi ya maendeleo ya kupoteza kumbukumbu na hazirudishii utendaji wa ubongo wa awali.

Dawa nyingine huitwa memantine. Inafanya kazi kwa kulenga receptor ya glutamate katika ubongo. Kama ilivyo kwa vinavyodhibiti cholinesterase, athari sio kubwa na matokeo yake tu ni kupunguza kasi ya kupoteza kumbukumbu.

Zote hizi dawa ni za jenetiki (generic), na ni sawa kuzijaribu kuona jinsi mtu atavyojibu.

Dawa moja ya mwisho kutajwa ni lecanemab. Ni sindano ya IV inayolenga amyloid, aina ya protini inayokua katika ubongo wa watu wenye demensia ya Alzheimer. Dawa hii inaonekana kufanya kazi vizuri kuondoa amyloid kwenye ubongo wa wagonjwa. Dawa hii ni ghali sana ($26,500 kwa mwaka) na imehusishwa na kuongezeka kwa pigo la damu (strokes). Katika tafiti, dalili za demensia zilipunguzwa kwa takriban asilimia 30 ikilinganishwa na placebo.

Hakana dawa nyingine zilizoidhinishwa kwa sasa kutibu demensia.

Terapia zisizo za Dawa

Kuna mambo kadhaa ambayo watu wanaweza kufanya kusaidia kupunguza kasi ya maendeleo ya demensia. Haya yanaweza kusaidia watu walio na historia ya familia yenye nguvu ya demensia na wanataka kuzuia kuibuka kwake.

Mazoezi ya moyo na mishipa (cardiovascular exercise) ni muhimu sana. Madaktari hutaja mazoezi kuhusiana karibu na kila ugonjwa sugu kwa sababu imeonyeshwa kufanya kazi. Kwa demensia, watu wanaofanya mazoezi mara kwa mara wana takriban asilimia 30 ya kupungua kwa hatari ya kupata ugonjwa huo. Mazoezi ya kawaida yanaonekana kupunguza kasi ya maendeleo ya demensia.4

Kufanya fumbo zinazohitaji shughuli za akili, kama Sudoku au fumbo la maneno (crossword puzzles) kunaonekana kusaidia kupunguza kasi ya kupoteza kumbukumbu na pia inaweza kupunguza nafasi ya kupata demensia.

Mwisho, ni msaada kujifunza kitu kipya. Watu wanaojifunza ujuzi mpya au kujikita katika kujifunza lugha mpya wanaimarisha kumbukumbu zao kwa kiasi kikubwa. Utafiti ulikuwa ukilinganisha wazee waliokua wakijifunza ujuzi mpya na watu waliokwenda hafla za kijamii.

Hoja ni kwamba ubongo wetu unahitaji kusukumwa kuunda njia mpya au zitavurugika.

Kumtunza Mtu wenye Demensia

Kumtunga mtu mwenye demensia ni changamoto kwa njia mbalimbali. Mara nyingi ni vigumu kujua ni uhuru gani wa kumruhusu mtu huyo. Kuna vitabu vingi vimeandikwa juu ya suala hili, lakini kuna mambo machache yanayostahili kutajwa.

Ni muhimu kuepuka vitu hatari. Vitu viwili hatari kwa mtu mwenye kumbukumbu duni ni kuendesha gari na kupika. Vyote hivi vinaonekana vya kawaida, na mtu anaweza kuonekana anafanya vizuri, lakini vinaweza kuwa tatizo haraka sana.

Hatari ya kuendesha gari ni mbili. Kwanza, baadhi ya watu huingia hofu katika hatua fulani, wakasahau jinsi ya kufanya ujuzi fulani. Hii inaweza kuwa tatizo, si kwao tu bali kwa wengine barabarani.

Pili, wazee wanaweza kuanza safari fupi hadi duka la karibu au mgahawa na kumalizika kupotea. Nimekuwa na wagonjwa waliomalizika waendesha gari kwa masaa wakijaribu kupata njia ya kurudi nyumbani walipoghazuka kuendesha gari kwenda mji.

Kupika, kwa kweli, ni suala la kukumbuka kuweka kengele na kuondoa vitu juu ya sufuria au kwenye oven kwa wakati unaofaa.

Mara nyingi, watu wenye demensia hawagundui ni kiasi gani uwezo wao umepungua na wanakataa wazo la kuachia funguo za gari. Labda ni kupoteza uhuru tu, lakini ni vigumu kukabiliana na ukweli kwamba hauko tena salama nyuma ya gurudumu.

Jaribu kuweka mambo sawa ndani ya chumba na nyumbani. Hata mabadiliko madogo katika mpangilio wa chumba yanaweza kutosha kuleta msongamano. Kumweka mtu kutoka nyumbani kwake — kwa mfano, kumuingiza hospitalini mara nyingi kunafanya mambo yakawa mabaya zaidi. Ghafla, kuchanganyikiwa ambacho kilionekana kuwa kidogo hapo awali sasa kimeongezeka sana.

Iwapo kuna tunda la Roho ambalo ni muhimu kwa kushughulika na mtu mwenye demensia, ni uvumilivu. Hakuna wetu mwenye uvumilivu wa kutosha kadri inavyohitajika; demensia inapopita huifanya uvumilivu huo kuwa mdogo sana.

Watu wenye demensia mara nyingi huonekana kama watoto safari ndefu. Wanauliza mara kwa mara wanaporudi nyumbani. Wanauliza kuhusu jamaa waliokufa au kwanini watoto bado hawajarudi nyumbani. Hakuna maelezo yoyote ambayo yanasaidia, kwa sababu dakika au mbili baada ya kuuliza swali, wamemsahau jibu na wanauliza tena.

Ujuzi wao mara nyingi huzorota na kuongezeka. Siku moja, wanaweza kufunga shati zao, na siku inayofuata, ujuzi huo unaonekana kumtoka dirishani. Ni rahisi kuamini kwamba hawawezi “kujijaribu” zaidi na kwamba wangefanya zaidi iwapo wangejitahidi tu.

Kwa bahati mbaya, ukweli kwamba mtu mwenye demensia angeweza kufanya kitu jana haimaanishi wanaweza kukumbuka jinsi ya kukifanya leo. Kukasirika nao kunafanya mambo haya kuwa mabaya zaidi kwani kunaongeza wasiwasi kwa mtu ambaye tayari hana kumbukumbu ya jinsi ya kufanya ujuzi fulani.

Kadri iwezekanavyo, jibu mtu huyo kwa upole hata ikiwa ni mara ya hamsini unayojibu swali sawa. Tumia vichocheo pia. Ikiwa kuna shughuli wanazoweza bado kufanya, kama kushona au fumbo za jigsaw (hata fumbo za watoto zenye vipande vikubwa), waweke kufanya hivyo. Mwishoni mwa ugonjwa, kuwaruhusu kutazama vitabu vyenye picha nzuri au wakati mwingine kuwapa mtoto-mwanaume (baby doll) kushika kunaweza kuwastawisha na kuwafanya wasiwe na wasiwasi wa wakati huo.

Pata Wengine Wa Kusaidia

Ni rahisi kuchoshwa. Kujaribu kutoa huduma zote peke yako si suluhisho la muda mrefu. Utunzaji wa demensia ni mbio ya umbali mrefu si mwendo wa kasi. Watu wengi huishi kwa miaka baada ya utambuzi, na ingawa miili yao ya kimwili inabaki kuwa imara, wanahitaji huduma zaidi na zaidi.

Mmoja wa baraka za kuwa na uhusiano wa kifamilia na jamii za kanisa ni kwamba tunao watu waliopo kutoa msaada.

Kumekuwa na wanajamii au marafiki kuingia ili kukupa mapumziko ni muhimu ili usichome kabisa au hata kuharamia kwa hasira dhidi ya mtu unayempenda. Ni bora kuchukua muda wa kupumzika mara kwa mara kabla hujaisha kiakili. Unaweza kufikiri uko sawa, lakini sisi sote tuna mwelekeo wa kuchoka katika kufanya mema ikiwa hatupati pumziko.

Hitimisho

Napenda kama kungekuwa suluhisho za kiafya zaidi kwa demensia. Labda zaidi yataja baadaye. Kwa sasa, dawa ni chache sana.

Kifungu muhimu ni kutekeleza tunda la Roho. “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance: against such there is no law” (Galatians 5:22-23).

Hata siku zilizokuwa za kuchosha zaidi, watu wanaoshughulika na upotevu mkubwa wa kumbukumbu wanahitaji upendo, upole, na uvumilivu kutoka kwa wanajamii wao. Ni kupitia tu nguvu ya Roho Mtakatifu tunaoweza kutoa utunzaji unaohitajika kwa mtu ambaye mwili wake ni imara, lakini ambaye hawezi hata kukutambua tena.

Part 1

For Alice, life is exasperating. Each day feels like an endless grind. She loves her family, but in her heart, she questions if what she is working so hard to accomplish makes any difference at all. She didn’t always feel bogged down, and she wondered what changed to make her feel overwhelmed so much of the time.

Sometimes busyness increases so gradually that we barely recognize the change. Busyness, given the chance, will overload us with more obligations than we can realistically get done in one day, or one week, or even one lifetime. Then, without warning, we reach the overload point when we feel as though we cannot possibly handle any more. Relentless overload can cause physical and mental exhaustion to the point where we feel deprived of enthusiasm, energy, and purpose. Some women seem to have a built-in indicator of where the overload line is. Others, like myself, struggle to find that balance. Constantly. There are so many good, interesting, and exciting options right at our fingertips; without much thought, we fill our days.

Concepts that contribute to overload

Playing multiple roles can be stressful. Overloading yourself with responsibilities and commitments can make you forget what is most important. It is easy to equate busyness with self-worth. By default, we start believing that:

  • Homemakers are capable of handling everything.
  • Homemakers, especially godly homemakers, are never frustrated.
  • A homemaker should anticipate all her family’s needs.

If we are honest, we know that these statements are unrealistic. Homemakers cannot do everything. All homemakers experience frustration occasionally. A mother cannot consistently be one step ahead of her family’s needs.

Rethinking the busy life

Household duties and caring for our families fill our days. Sometimes those tasks alone make us extremely busy. But what about the extra-circular activities or the high standard we hold ourselves to? We may need to think differently so we can break free from habits that threaten to control us.

Accept your limits

Maybe you can go to a Tupperware party, attend a Bible study, and repaint the bathroom all in one week. But should you? Good homemakers allow themselves to simplify even if they prefer doing it another way. That means if you are an avid bread maker, it’s all right to toss a few loaves of bread into your shopping cart.

Evaluate what causes frustrations

Artificial smiles can hide inner frustrations, but it doesn’t cure them. It works best to admit that there is a problem and then seek a solution. I’ve had to learn this repeatedly. All my family members know that we eat dinner at 5:30. But a late arrival habit is trending, and it bothers me.

When I told my husband about the frustration, he simply said, “Why don’t you explain the issue and quit being so uptight about it?” Good point. Proactively seeking solutions works for many problem areas.

Imperfect women make good homemakers

Quit worrying about perfection and make decisions based on what is best for today. Fun-loving, happy, homemakers might have a few dust bunnies under the furniture, but they radiate an aura that draws people to their hearts and homes.

Everyone differs when it comes to how much we can handle. On the other hand, everyone is the same; we all have limits. In future installments, we will discuss how to deal with common points of overload.

Part 2

Many homemakers find themselves stretched thin among commitments that go with home, family, and other activities. As busy as we are, why do we continue to fill our schedules fuller?

It is easy for me to commit to a new project and then realize, halfway into the task, that I have overstepped my limits. Too often, I overestimate the amount of time I must have to complete a project and underestimate the amount of time a task will take.

Commitment overload happens by default. When we play multiple roles and add more responsibilities, we can easily become slaves to the promises we have made. Overload tends to drain our energy, dull our senses, and deaden our joy.

Recognizing Overload

Sometimes multiple activities take place in rapid sequence. Normally, we can flow with short-term spurts of busyness. But if the flow of activities is never-ending and we keep adding more obligations, we develop a pattern that becomes a way of life.

Too many commitments beyond normal duties make us candidates for depression and burnout. Personally, when I experience insomnia, apathy, or irritability, it is time to examine my schedule. If adjustments aren’t made, someone or something will suffer.

No one can overextend themselves indefinitely. Sometimes we suffer consequences for keeping a pace that is beyond our resources. Symptoms of overload can include lack of sleep, strained relationships, procrastination, fear of failure, and a susceptible immune system.

Breaking Free of Overload

Identifying overload takes an honest evaluation of yourself. How can you know if this is just a busy season or if busyness is the new normal? Are you declining a request because life is too full, or is it an excuse? Do you have to say “yes” on the spot? With practice, you can learn how to pull back before reaching the overload point.

Let an idea or request gel before committing

This has saved me a great deal of stress. There are so many good things to be involved in, and new inspirations come daily. Sometimes tasks can be incorporated into my/our schedule. Other times I must simply let them go and stay focused on what is most important. Consider waiting a few hours before incorporating new ideas and requests.

Seek advice, especially your husband’s

A renowned doughnut maker was asked to have a stand at an auction. She asked her husband what he thought about it. He said, “As long as you don’t complain and stress about it like you did last year, I don’t care.” Was her husband saying “yes” or “no”? This lady should take the cue that doughnut making was somehow adding stress. Either she should not do it, or together they must seek a workable solution.

Evaluate your schedule regularly

Keep a detailed calendar to have a picture of past, present, and future events. If your family had the flu last week and you plan to take an out-of-state trip next week, should you add more? What is the emotional health of your family? Is your husband stressed at work? Sometimes it is better to have a time slot of nothing so it can be filled with what is important now. You can’t do a good job at anything if you are spread too thin. Too many obligations make it hard to be personally refreshed and congenial. Choosing commitments wisely will help you invest your energy where it is most valuable for today.

Parte 1

Per Alice, la vita è esasperante. Ogni giorno sembra una fatica senza fine. Ama la sua famiglia, ma nel suo cuore si chiede se ciò per cui si impegna così tanto faccia davvero la differenza. Non si è sempre sentita appesantita, e si domandava cosa fosse cambiato per farla sentire sopraffatta così spesso.

A volte l’accumularsi degli impegni aumenta così gradualmente che quasi non ce ne rendiamo conto. La vita frenetica, se le si dà modo, ci sovraccaricherà di più obblighi di quanti realisticamente possiamo portare a termine in un giorno, in una settimana, o perfino in una vita. Poi, senza preavviso, raggiungiamo il punto di sovraccarico in cui ci sembra di non poter più far fronte a nulla. Un sovraccarico incessante può causare esaurimento fisico e mentale al punto che ci sentiamo privati di entusiasmo, energia e senso. Alcune donne sembrano avere un indicatore incorporato che segnala dov’è la soglia del sovraccarico. Altre, come me, faticano a trovare quell’equilibrio. Costantemente. Ci sono così tante opzioni buone, interessanti ed entusiasmanti a portata di mano; senza pensarci troppo, riempiamo le nostre giornate.

Concetti che contribuiscono al sovraccarico

Interpretare più ruoli può essere fonte di stress. Sovraccaricarsi di responsabilità e impegni può farti dimenticare ciò che è più importante. È facile equiparare la frenesia al proprio valore. Per impostazione predefinita, cominciamo a credere che:

  • Le casalinghe siano capaci di gestare tutto.
  • Le casalinghe, specialmente quelle pie, non siano mai frustrate.
  • Una casalinga dovrebbe prevedere tutti i bisogni della sua famiglia.

Se siamo oneste, sappiamo che queste affermazioni sono irrealistiche. Le casalinghe non possono fare tutto. Tutte le casalinghe provano frustrazione di tanto in tanto. Una madre non può essere costantemente un passo avanti rispetto alle necessità della sua famiglia.

Rivedere la vita frenetica

I doveri domestici e la cura delle nostre famiglie riempiono le nostre giornate. Talvolta solo questi compiti ci rendono estremamente occupate. Ma che dire delle attività extracurricolari o dello standard elevato che imponiamo a noi stesse? Potremmo aver bisogno di pensare diversamente per liberarci da abitudini che minacciano di controllarci.

Accetta i tuoi limiti

Forse puoi andare a una festa del Tupperware, partecipare a uno studio biblico e ridipingere il bagno tutto nella stessa settimana. Ma dovresti farlo? Le buone casalinghe si permettono di semplificare anche se preferirebbero fare le cose in un altro modo. Questo significa che se sei un’appassionata di panificazione, va bene mettere qualche pagnotta nel carrello della spesa.

Valuta ciò che causa le frustrazioni

I sorrisi finti possono nascondere frustrazioni interiori, ma non le curano. È meglio ammettere che c’è un problema e poi cercare una soluzione. Ho dovuto impararlo più volte. Tutti in famiglia sanno che ceniamo alle 17:30. Ma si sta diffondendo l’abitudine di arrivare in ritardo, e questo mi dà fastidio.

Quando ho parlato della frustrazione a mio marito, lui ha detto semplicemente: “Perché non spieghi il problema e smetti di essere così tesa a riguardo?” Buon punto. Cercare proattivamente soluzioni funziona per molte aree problematiche.

Donne imperfette fanno buone casalinghe

Smetti di preoccuparti della perfezione e prendi decisioni basate su ciò che è meglio per oggi. Le casalinghe allegre e amanti del divertimento possono avere qualche pallina di polvere sotto i mobili, ma emettono un’aura che attrae le persone verso il loro cuore e la loro casa.

Ognuna di noi è diversa per quanto riguarda quanto può sopportare. D’altro canto, siamo tutte uguali; abbiamo tutti dei limiti. Nei prossimi articoli discuteremo come affrontare i punti comuni di sovraccarico.

Parte 2

Molte casalinghe si trovano tirate da mille impegni che riguardano la casa, la famiglia e altre attività. Per quanto siamo occupate, perché continuiamo a riempire sempre di più i nostri programmi?

Per me è facile impegnarmi in un nuovo progetto e poi rendermi conto, a metà strada, di aver superato i miei limiti. Troppe volte sovrastimo il tempo di cui devo disporre per portare a termine un progetto e sottovalutiamo il tempo che un compito richiederà.

Il sovraccarico di impegni avviene per impostazione predefinita. Quando ricopriamo più ruoli e aggiungiamo più responsabilità, possiamo facilmente diventare schiave delle promesse che abbiamo fatto. Il sovraccarico tende a prosciugare la nostra energia, a intorpidire i nostri sensi e ad appiattire la nostra gioia.

Riconoscere il sovraccarico

A volte molte attività si susseguono in rapida sequenza. Normalmente possiamo affrontare brevi ondate di attività frenetica. Ma se il flusso di attività è incessante e continuiamo ad aggiungere obblighi, sviluppiamo un modello che diventa uno stile di vita.

Troppi impegni oltre ai doveri normali ci rendono candidate alla depressione e al burnout. Personalmente, quando sperimento insonnia, apatia o irritabilità, è il momento di esaminare il mio programma. Se non si effettuano aggiustamenti, qualcuno o qualcosa ne risentirà.

Nessuno può spingersi oltre i propri limiti indefinitamente. A volte subiamo conseguenze per mantenere un ritmo al di là delle nostre risorse. I sintomi del sovraccarico possono includere mancanza di sonno, relazioni tese, procrastinazione, paura di fallire e un sistema immunitario vulnerabile.

Liberarsi dal sovraccarico

Identificare il sovraccarico richiede una valutazione onesta di se stesse. Come puoi sapere se si tratta solo di una stagione intensa o se la frenesia è la nuova normalità? Stai rifiutando una richiesta perché la vita è troppo piena, o è una scusa? Devi dire “sì” sul momento? Con l’esercizio, puoi imparare a tirarti indietro prima di raggiungere il punto di sovraccarico.

Lascia che un’idea o una richiesta sedimentino prima di impegnarti

Questo mi ha salvato da molto stress. Ci sono così tante cose buone in cui essere coinvolte, e nuove ispirazioni arrivano ogni giorno. A volte i compiti possono essere integrati nel mio/nostro programma. Altre volte devo semplicemente lasciarli andare e rimanere concentrata su ciò che è più importante. Considera di aspettare qualche ora prima di incorporare nuove idee e richieste.

Cerca consigli, specialmente da tuo marito

Una rinomata produttrice di ciambelle fu invitata a tenere uno stand a un’asta. Chiese a suo marito cosa ne pensasse. Lui disse: “Finché non ti lamenti e non ti stressi come l’anno scorso, a me non importa.” Stava dicendo “sì” o “no”? Questa signora dovrebbe cogliere il suggerimento che la preparazione delle ciambelle stava in qualche modo aggiungendo stress. O non dovrebbe farlo, o insieme devono trovare una soluzione praticabile.

Valuta regolarmente il tuo programma

Tieni un calendario dettagliato per avere un quadro degli eventi passati, presenti e futuri. Se la tua famiglia ha avuto l’influenza la settimana scorsa e prevedi di fare un viaggio fuori stato la prossima settimana, dovresti aggiungere altro? Qual è la salute emotiva della tua famiglia? Tuo marito è stressato al lavoro? A volte è meglio avere una fascia oraria vuota in modo che possa essere riempita da ciò che è importante ora. Non puoi fare bene nulla se sei troppo dispersa. Troppi obblighi rendono difficile essere ristorate personalmente e piacevoli. Scegliere gli impegni con saggezza ti aiuterà a investire la tua energia dove è più preziosa per oggi.

A wonderful thing about being a Christian is anticipating the day when we feast our eyes on the magnificent beauty of our God. Quite likely, we have all created mental pictures of what we think God might look like, although we know that our wildest imaginations will be exceeded. “Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off” (Isaiah 33:17). The Bible is full of descriptive word pictures attempting to give us a brief glimpse into the realms of the heavenly. The landscape on the hills of glory, the wonderful creatures that dwell there, and most of all, the Supreme Being on the throne, all defy our human attempt to grasp and understand the beauty and glory of our God.

At times we admire beauty in a song, a work of art, a story, or even another person, but David describes the delight of gazing at the beauty of God. “One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple” (Psalm 27:4). God is beautiful because His excellence is attractive— His character is flawless. David experienced the pleasure that comes from knowing and experiencing God in all His fullness. How does God express His Beauty?

Through the Gospel

“In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them. For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake. For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ” (2 Corinthians 4:4-6). In the awfulness of the Passion of Christ, we find a profound and sober beauty— the beauty of a sacrifice made by a sinless Savior for undeserving humanity. Sometimes the most stirring kind of beauty is found in things we cannot fully comprehend.

There is beauty in weeping of Mary and the disciples around the cross that held the lifeless body of their beloved Master. But when dawn broke on resurrection morning, despair turned into hope and grief into joy.

We see a beautiful scene at the Mount of Olives forty days later as the same disciples wistfully gazed into the sky, watching as their risen Lord disappeared into the heavens. With great joy, they returned to Jerusalem, with the promise of His return burning in their hearts, to wait for the coming of the Holy Spirit.

Today we expectantly wait for the Son of God to appear from heaven with power and great glory to complete the work of salvation. Then will we look upon Him in all His splendor and beauty. “For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known” (1 Corinthians 13:12).

How should we, as God's image-bearers, reflect His beauty through the Gospel? God is an uncreated eternal being, and man was created in His image to reflect His glory and beauty. However, this beauty has been marred by sin and is no longer a worthy representation of God's character. But, there is redemption! Very little surpasses the beauty of a life that was once bruised and broken by sin but is now restored, redeemed, and made whole by the Gospel. “To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He might be glorified” (Isaiah 61:3). Atheists challenge the existence of God, scientists argue against Biblical creation, scholars question the inerrancy of scripture, but nobody can dispute the testimony of a redeemed life.

Through Creation

“The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament showeth His handy work” (Psalm 19:1). All beauty in the created world comes from God. A beautiful sunset, a lovely rose, a towering redwood, a majestic mountain peak, all testify of the beauty of God illustrated in creation. As road signs along the highway guide us to our destination, likewise, creation directs mankind to God himself. “For the invisible things of Him from the creation of the world are clearly seen . . .” (Romans 1:20). These gifts of creation are given to give us a brief glimpse of the One who created them.

How should we, as part of God's creation, reflect His creative beauty? Although we cannot make something out of nothing, God has designed us to be creative, using the resources of His creation and our intellectual abilities to make life practical. The fulfilling sense of accomplishment derived from a job well done has its origin in creation, where God regarded His work and declared it to be good. In our attempt to live non-extravagant lives we sometimes fail to take joy in the beautiful things in life. It is right and good and in harmony with how we were created to find pleasure in things of beauty. Ungodly men have used this gift of creativity many times for evil means. So much the more, let us glorify God by using His creation in ways that reflect His character.

A warning for all who love nature and creation (natural and man-made): let us be careful to not elevate earthly beauty above the Creator, which leads to idolatry. Sunsets fade, redwoods tumble, roses wilt, the human body turns to dust again, but God remains. Life and all of its beauty begins and ends with God.

Through Music and Sound

“And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps” (Revelation 14:2) According to the book of Revelation, God's throne is surrounded by sound: thundering and lightning; praises flowing from the angels, the four beasts and twenty elders, and the great multitude which no man can number; and the new song by the one hundred and forty four thousand.

God created the beauty of sound to glorify Himself in ways that mere words cannot. The intricacy of His creativity is powerfully displayed in the way various sound frequencies come together to create a beautiful and heavenly harmony. It is honoring to God for mankind to take pleasure in the beauty of sounds He has created for His glory. The person who loves God will be drawn to Him whenever He is serenaded by pleasing sounds: the people of God singing the songs of Zion, the prayers of the saints, the wind whispering through the treetops, the songbird praising its Maker, the rumble of thunder, or the simple patter of rain on the roof.

How should we, as instruments of sound, reflect God's beauty through sound? We should always seek to listen to and resemble the sounds and harmonies of heaven. Although we will never be able to completely accomplish this on earth, it should be a lifelong endeavor. The questions have been asked,” Should we always be trying to improve our music making?” and “when have we reached ‘good enough’?” We will never be able to attain heavenly perfection, so the question should rather be asked, “Are we giving God the best we have?” Some people have more singing capabilities than others, but the question remains. “Are we giving our best or are we satisfied with an inferior sacrifice?” Let us be producers of God-honoring sounds that bring joy to the heart of the Creator!

Through the Church:

The Bible speaks extensively about the beauty of God's people. “Zion,” “The Temple,” “The Mountain of God,” “Jerusalem,” and“The Church” are synonymous expressions woven throughout scripture referring to the habitation of God's people on the earth. It is God's desire that His beauty would be reflected in the lives of His people. “Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of His holiness. Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King” (Psalm 48:1-2).

Nothing is dearer to the heart of God than His church. When the children of Israel journeyed through the wilderness, they built the tabernacle as a place for God to dwell among them. When Solomon dedicated the temple as God's dwelling place, God was very pleased and 2 Chronicles 7:1 says the glory of the Lord filled the temple. The temple was considered the House of the Lord–Jesus himself referred to it numerous times as God's house and was very passionate that it should be kept holy.

Today, neither the tabernacle nor the temple hosts the presence of God but rather His divine passion is concentrated on the church of Jesus Christ. Here are the people who truly love Him and are willing to lay down their lives for Him. Here are the people who are willing to give up their rights as individuals and surrender themselves to a greater cause. Here is where many a saint has given His very life's blood for the Gospel. And here is where one day our Savior will return as He has promised, and will transport His bride, the church, to her eternal habitation. “And I John saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be His people, and God Himself shall be with them, and be their God” (Revelation 21:2-3).

How should we, as God's people, reflect His beauty in the church? By dwelling together in unity and harmony with love for all men, especially the household of God. The church should be a place where the world can get a glimpse of what goes on in heaven. It should be a place where Christ is always elevated as the victorious conqueror of sin, death, and hell.

Sadly, many people have become disoriented with the church's failures and have walked away from the true apostolic faith. In spite of our disappointments, let us “lift up the hands which hang down and the feeble knees” (Hebrews 12:12) and let us press on. We will never have a higher calling, and never a more noble warfare to wage.

Lastly, how should we reflect His beauty in our lives? By delighting in Him. “Delight thyself also in the LORD; and He shall give thee the desires of thine heart” (Psalm 37:4). The greatest fulfillment in life comes from finding pleasure in bringing joy to the heart of God by delighting in what He delights in and loving what He loves. Let us never lose the wonder of the beauty of our Salvation!

क्रिश्चियन होने की एक अद्भुत बात यह है कि हम उस दिन की प्रतीक्षा करते हैं जब हम अपने परमेश्वर की विशिष्ट सुंदरता को निहारा करेंगे। संभवतः हम सबने यह कल्पना की है कि परमेश्वर कैसे दिखते होंगे, यद्यपि हम जानते हैं कि हमारी सबसे ज़्यादा कल्पनाएँ भी उससे परे होंगी। “Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off” (Isaiah 33:17)। बाइबिल वर्णनात्मक शब्दचित्रों से भरी है जो हमें स्वर्गीय आयामों की संक्षिप्त झलक देने की कोशिश करती हैं। महिमा के टीले पर दृश्य, वहां रहने वाली अद्भुत सृष्टियाँ, और सबसे बढ़कर, सिंहासन पर परमेश्वर—ये सब हमारी मानवीय समझ और पकड़ की सीमा को चुनौती देते हैं।

कभी-कभी हम किसी गीत, किसी कला-कृति, किसी कहानी, या किसी अन्य व्यक्ति में सुंदरता की प्रशंसा करते हैं, परंतु दाउद परमेश्वर की सुंदरता को निहारने की खुशी का वर्णन करते हैं। “One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple” (Psalm 27:4)। परमेश्वर सुंदर हैं क्योंकि उनकी उत्कृष्टता आकर्षक है—उनका चरित्र निःदोष है। दाउद ने परमेश्वर को सम्पूर्णतया जानने और अनुभव करने से होने वाली आनन्द की अनुभूति पाई। परमेश्वर अपनी सुंदरता को कैसे व्यक्त करते हैं?

Through the Gospel

“In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them. For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake. मरियम और शिष्यों का क्रॉस के चारों ओर रश्क-भीगे आँसू बहाना सुंदर है, जहाँ उनके प्रिय स्वामी का निर्जीव शरीर पड़ा था। परन्तु पुनरुत्थान की सुबह के आते ही निराशा आशा में बदल गई और शोक हर्ष में परिवर्तित हो गया।

चालीस दिन बाद ऑलिवेट की पहाड़ी पर एक सुंदर दृश्य दिखता है जब वही शिष्य आसमान की ओर देखते हुए अपनी पुनरुत्थित प्रभु को नभ में जाते देख रहे थे। बड़ी प्रसन्नता के साथ वे यरूशलेम लौटे, उनके हृदयों में उसके लौटने के वचन की ज्वाला जलती हुई, पवित्र आत्मा के आगमन की प्रतीक्षा करने के लिए।

आज हम उत्सुकतापूर्वक प्रतीक्षा करते हैं कि परमेश्वर का पुत्र स्वर्ग से महिमा और सामर्थ्य के साथ प्रकट होगा और उद्धार के कार्य को पूर्ण करेगा। तब हम उसे उसकी सारी शोभा और सुंदरता में देखेंगे। “For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known” (1 Corinthians 13:12)।

हम, परमेश्वर की प्रतिमा वाले के रूप में, सुसमाचार के द्वारा उसकी सुंदरता को कैसे प्रतिबिंबित करें? परमेश्वर एक अनिर्मित शाश्वत सत्ता हैं, और मनुष्य उनके प्रतिबिंब के रूप में निर्मित हुआ ताकि उसकी महिमा और सुंदरता को दर्शा सके। परंतु, यह सुंदरता पाप से धुँधली हो गई है और अब परमेश्वर के चरित्र का योग्य प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं रह गया। परन्तु, मुक्ति है! उस जीवन की सुंदरता से कम ही कुछ श्रेष्ठ है जो कभी पाप से घायल और टूट चुका था परन्तु अब सुसमाचार द्वारा पुनर्स्थापित, मुक्त और पूर्ण कर दिया गया है। “To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He might be glorified” (Isaiah 61:3)। नास्तिक परमेश्वर के अस्तित्व को चुनौती देते हैं, वैज्ञानिक बाइबिल निर्माण के विरुद्ध तर्क करते हैं, विद्वान शास्त्र की अप्रतिष्ठता पर सवाल उठाते हैं, परन्तु किसी ने भी एक उद्धारित जीवन की गवाही का खंडन नहीं किया है।

Through Creation

“The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament showeth His handy work” (Psalm 19:1)। सृष्टि की सभी सुंदरता परमेश्वर से आती है। एक सुंदर सूर्यास्त, एक सुरम्य गुलाब, एक विशाल रेडवुड वृक्ष, एक भव्य पर्वत चोटि—ये सब सृष्टि में परमेश्वर की सुंदरता का प्रमाण हैं। जिस प्रकार राजमार्ग पर लगे संकेत हमें मंज़िल तक पहुँचाते हैं, उसी प्रकार सृष्टि मनुष्यता को स्वयं परमेश्वर की ओर निर्देशित करती है। “For the invisible things of Him from the creation of the world are clearly seen . . .” (Romans 1:20)। ये सृष्टि के उपहार हमें उन्हें बनाया जिसने उन्हें बनाया है, उसकी एक संक्षिप्त झलक देने के लिए दिए गए हैं।

हम, परमेश्वर की सृष्टि का हिस्सा होकर, उसकी रचनात्मक सुंदरता को कैसे प्रतिबिंबित करें? यद्यपि हम कुछ भी से कुछ बनाने में सक्षम नहीं हैं, परमेश्वर ने हमें रचनात्मक बनाने का नियोजन किया है, ताकि हम उसकी सृष्टि के संसाधनों और अपनी बौद्धिक क्षमताओं का उपयोग कर जीवन को व्यावहारिक बना सकें। एक अच्छे से किए गए कार्य से मिलने वाली संतोषजनक पूर्ति की अनुभूति की जड़ रचना में है, जहाँ परमेश्वर ने अपने कार्य को देखा और उसे अच्छा कहा। साधारण जीवन जीने के प्रयास में हम कभी-कभी जीवन की सुंदर बातों में आनन्द लेना भूल जाते हैं। सुंदर चीज़ों में आनंद पाना सही और अच्छा है और यह हमारे निर्माण के अनुरूप है। अधार्मिक पुरुषों ने इस रचनात्मक उपहार का कई बार दुरुपयोग किया है। अतः और भी अधिक, आइए हम परमेश्वर की महिमा के लिए उसकी सृष्टि का उपयोग ऐसे तरीकों से करें जो उसके चरित्र को प्रतिबिंबित करें।

प्रकृति और सृष्टि (प्राकृतिक और मानव-निर्मित) से प्रेम रखने वालों के लिए एक चेतावनी: हमें सावधान रहना चाहिए कि हम पृथ्वी की सुंदरता को निर्माता से ऊपर न उठाएँ, क्योंकि यह मूर्तिपूजा की ओर ले जाता है। सूर्यास्त फीके पड़ जाते हैं, रेडवुड गिर जाते हैं, गुलाब मुरझा जाते हैं, मानव शरीर फिर धूल में बदल जाता है, परन्तु परमेश्वर बना रहता है। जीवन और इसकी सारी सुंदरता परमेश्वर के साथ शुरू होती है और उसी में समाप्त होती है।

Through Music and Sound

“And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps” (Revelation 14:2) प्रकाशितवाक्य के अनुसार, परमेश्वर के सिंहासन के चारों ओर ध्वनि है: गरजती हुई और बिजली; देवदूतों, चार निर्जीव प्राणियों और बीस बुजुर्गों से निकलने वाले स्तवन; और वह बहुत बड़ी भीड़ जिसका कोई गणना न कर सके; तथा एक सौ चालीस चार हजार द्वारा गाया गया नया गीत।

परमेश्वर ने शब्दों से परे महिमा पाने के लिए ध्वनि की सुंदरता बनाई। उसके रचनात्मक जटिलता का शक्तिशाली प्रदर्शन इस तरह होता है कि विभिन्न ध्वनि आवृत्तियाँ एक साथ आकर एक सुंदर और स्वर्गीय सामंजस्य बनाती हैं। मनुष्य के लिए उस सुंदरता में आनन्द लेना परमेश्वर की महिमा के लिए सम्मानजनक है। जो व्यक्ति परमेश्वर से प्रेम करता है वह ऐसी मधुर ध्वनियों द्वारा आकर्षित होगा: दाऊद के लोगों के ज़ायोन के गीत गाना, संतों की प्रार्थनाएँ, वृक्षों की चोटी में फुसफुसाती हवा, चिड़िया का अपने निर्माणकर्ता की स्तुति करना, गरजती बिजली की गड़गड़ाहट, या छत पर वर्षा की साधारण टपकन।

हम, ध्वनि के उपकरणों के रूप में, ध्वनि द्वारा परमेश्वर की सुंदरता को कैसे प्रतिबिंबित करें? हमें हमेशा स्वर्ग की ध्वनियों और सामंजस्यों को सुनने और उनका अनुकरण करने का प्रयास करना चाहिए। यद्यपि हम पृथ्वी पर इसे पूर्ण रूप से प्राप्त नहीं कर पाएँगे, यह जीवन भर का प्रयत्न होना चाहिए। प्रश्न उठे हैं, “क्या हमें हमेशा अपनी संगीत प्रस्तुति सुधारने का प्रयास करना चाहिए?” और “कब हम ‘पर्याप्त अच्छा’ हो चुके हैं?” हम स्वर्गीय पूर्णता कभी प्राप्त नहीं कर सकेंगे, अतः प्रश्न ऐसा होना चाहिए: “क्या हम परमेश्वर को जो सर्वश्रेष्ठ है वह दे रहे हैं?” कुछ लोगों के पास दूसरों की तुलना में अधिक गायन क्षमता होती है, पर प्रश्न वही रहता है: “क्या हम अपना सर्वश्रेष्ठ दे रहे हैं या हम निम्नतम बलिदान से संतुष्ट हैं?” आइए हम ऐसे परमेश्वर-मान्य ध्वनियों के निर्माता बनें जो स्रष्टा के हृदय में आनन्द लाएँ!

Through the Church:

बाइबिल व्यापक रूप से परमेश्वर के प्रजा की सुंदरता के बारे में बोलती है। “Zion,” “The Temple,” “The Mountain of God,” “Jerusalem,” और “The Church” ये समरूपी अभिव्यक्तियाँ हैं जो शास्त्र में परमेश्वर की पृथ्वी पर रहने वाली प्रजा के निवास को संदर्भित करती हैं। परमेश्वर की इच्छा है कि उसकी सुंदरता उसकी प्रजा के जीवन में परिलक्षित हो। “Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of His holiness. Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King” (Psalm 48:1-2)।

परमेश्वर के हृदय के लिए उसकी चर्च से बढ़कर कुछ नहीं प्यारा है। जब इज़राइल के बच्चे रेगिस्तान में चले जाते थे, उन्होंने प्रभु के बीच रहने के लिए कानाबे (tabernacle) बनाया। जब सोलोमन ने मंदिर को परमेश्वर का आवास समर्पित किया, तब परमेश्वर अत्यंत प्रसन्न हुआ और 2 Chronicles 7:1 कहता है कि प्रभु की महिमा ने मंदिर को भर दिया। मंदिर को प्रभु का घर माना जाता था—येसु ने खुद इसे कई बार परमेश्वर के घर के रूप में संदर्भित किया और वे इसे पवित्र रखा जाना चाहते थे।

आज, न तो कानाबे और न ही मंदिर परमेश्वर की उपस्थिति के स्थल हैं, बल्कि उनकी दैवीय आत्मा यीशु मसीह की चर्च पर केन्द्रित है। यहाँ वे लोग हैं जो वास्तव में उससे प्रेम करते हैं और उसके लिए अपना जीवन देने को तैयार हैं। यहाँ वे लोग हैं जो अपने व्यक्तिगत अधिकारों को त्यागकर एक बड़े कारण के लिए समर्पित होते हैं। यहाँ कई संतों ने सुसमाचार के लिए अपना जीवन-रक्त दिया है। और यहीं वह दिन आएगा जब हमारा उद्धारकर्ता जैसा उसने वादा किया है लौटेगा, और अपनी वर, चर्च, को उसके शाश्वत निवासस्थान पर ले जाएगा। “And I John saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be His people, and God Himself shall be with them, and be their God” (Revelation 21:2-3)।

हम, परमेश्वर की प्रजा के रूप में, चर्च में उसकी सुंदरता को कैसे प्रतिबिंबित करें? एकता और सामंजस्य में मिलकर रहकर और सभी मनुष्यों के प्रति प्रेम दिखाकर, खासकर परमेश्वर के घर के सदस्यों के प्रति। चर्च वह स्थान होना चाहिए जहाँ संसार यह झलक देख सके कि स्वर्ग में क्या होता है। यह ऐसा स्थान होना चाहिए जहाँ मसीह हमेशा पाप, मृत्यु और शैतान पर विजयी विजेता के रूप में ऊँचा दिखे।

दुर्भाग्यवश, कई लोग चर्च की विफलताओं से भटक कर सच्चे प्रेरितीय विश्वास से दूर हो गए हैं। अपनी निराशाओं के बावजूद, आइए हम “lift up the hands which hang down and the feeble knees” (Hebrews 12:12) और आगे बढ़ें। हमारे पास कभी भी अधिक ऊँचा आह्वान नहीं होगा, और न ही लड़ाई से अधिक महान संघर्ष होगा।

अंत में, अपने जीवन में हम उसकी सुंदरता को कैसे प्रतिबिंबित करें? उसकी प्रियता में आनंद लेकर। “Delight thyself also in the LORD; and He shall give thee the desires of thine heart” (Psalm 37:4)। जीवन में सबसे बड़ा परिपूर्ति उस आनंद में है जो हमें परमेश्वर के हृदय को आनन्द पहुँचाकर मिलता है—उसमें आनन्द लेना जो वह आनन्द करता है और प्रेम करना जो वह प्रेम करता है। आइए हम अपने उद्धार की सुंदरता का आश्चर्य कभी न खोएँ!
